title: 13 Seconds
note: 2021 Divisional, Bills at Chiefs, Jan 23, 2022. Allen's touchdown to Gabriel Davis put Buffalo up 36–33 with 13 seconds left. Your ball at your own 25, three timeouts. Mahomes needed two throws to get Butker a 49-yarder; the Chiefs won 42–36 in overtime.

title: Minneapolis Miracle
note: 2017 Divisional, Saints at Vikings, Jan 14, 2018. Lutz's field goal put New Orleans up 24–23 with 25 seconds left. Your ball at your own 20, one timeout, in field-goal range or bust. Keenum found Diggs down the sideline for 61 yards as the clock hit zero.

title: Foles to Ertz
note: Super Bowl LII, Feb 4, 2018. Brady's touchdown to Gronkowski gave New England a 33–32 lead with 9:22 left. Your ball at your own 25. The Eagles went 75 yards in 14 plays and took 7:02 off the clock; Ertz dove in with 2:21 to go.

title: 28–3: the last drive
note: Super Bowl LI, Feb 5, 2017. 28–3 had become 28–20. Your ball at your own 9 with 3:30 left and two timeouts. Edelman's catch off a shoe, White's touchdown, Amendola's two-point try, and the first overtime in Super Bowl history.

title: Seahawks at the 5
note: Super Bowl XLIX, Feb 1, 2015. Kearse's juggling catch put the ball at the New England 5 with 1:06 left, down 28–24, one timeout. First and goal. Lynch to the 1 on first down; what came next is the most second-guessed call in the game's history. Your call.

title: Mile High Miracle
note: 2012 Divisional, Ravens at Broncos, Jan 12, 2013. Down 35–28, your ball at your own 23, 1:09 left, no timeouts, in the cold. Flacco went deep for Jacoby Jones with 31 seconds left; the Ravens won in double overtime on their way to the title.

title: The Helmet Catch
note: Super Bowl XLII, Feb 3, 2008. The 18–0 Patriots led 14–10 with 2:39 left. Your ball at your own 17. Manning escaped the pile, Tyree pinned the ball to his helmet, and Burress scored with 35 seconds left.

title: Holmes in the corner
note: Super Bowl XLIII, Feb 1, 2009. Fitzgerald's 64-yard touchdown put Arizona up 23–20; a holding call backed you up to your own 12 with 2:24 left. Roethlisberger to Holmes for 40, then the toe-tap in the corner with 35 seconds to go.

title: Manningham on the sideline
note: Super Bowl XLVI, Feb 5, 2012. Down 17–15, your ball at your own 12, 3:46 left, one timeout. Manning's 38-yard sideline throw to Manningham, then Bradshaw's reluctant touchdown with 57 seconds left. Giants 21–17.

title: Brady's first
note: Super Bowl XXXVI, Feb 3, 2002. Tied 17–17, your ball at your own 17, 1:21 left, no timeouts. On the broadcast, Madden said to take a knee and play for overtime. Brady drove to the 30; Vinatieri hit from 48 as time expired.

title: One Yard Short
note: Super Bowl XXXIV, Jan 30, 2000. Warner's 73-yard touchdown to Bruce put the Rams up 23–16. Your ball at your own 12 with 1:48 left. McNair shook off two rushers to find Dyson at the 10; Mike Jones tackled him one yard short as the clock ran out.

title: Mahomes on one ankle
note: Super Bowl LVII, Feb 12, 2023. Tied 35–35, your ball at your own 25 with 5:15 left. Mahomes, on a high ankle sprain, scrambled 26 yards; the drive ran the clock to 0:08 before Butker's 27-yarder. Chiefs 38–35.

title: Super Bowl overtime
note: Super Bowl LVIII, Feb 11, 2024. San Francisco took the ball first in overtime and kicked a field goal: 22–19. Your ball at your own 25 with 7:22 left in the period. Under the playoff rules both teams get a possession; a field goal only ties it. 13 plays later, Mahomes to Hardman with three seconds left.

title: Stafford to Kupp
note: Super Bowl LVI, Feb 13, 2022. Down 20–16, your ball at your own 21 with 6:13 left. Stafford went to Kupp again and again, including on fourth and one; Kupp's touchdown with 1:25 left won it 23–20.

title: The Miami Miracle
note: Dec 9, 2018, Patriots at Dolphins. Down 33–28, your ball at your own 31, seven seconds left, no timeouts. One play. Tannehill to Stills, lateral to Parker, lateral to Drake, 69 yards, past Gronkowski at the goal line.

title: Jet Chip Wasp
note: Super Bowl LIV, Feb 2, 2020. Down 20–10, your ball at your own 17 with 8:53 left. On third and 15 Mahomes went deep to Hill for 44; the Chiefs scored 21 straight and won 31–20, their first title in 50 years.

title: Hail Murray
note: Nov 15, 2020, Bills at Cardinals. Allen's touchdown to Diggs put Buffalo up 30–26 with 34 seconds left. Your ball at your own 25, two timeouts. Murray rolled left and heaved it 43 yards; Hopkins came down with it between three Bills with two seconds left.

title: Favre, across his body
note: 2009 NFC Championship, Vikings at Saints, Jan 24, 2010. Tied 28–28, your ball at your own 33 with 1:39 left, two timeouts. The Vikings reached the 33; then twelve men in the huddle, then Favre rolled right and threw back across the field. Tracy Porter's interception; the Saints won in overtime.

title: Fitzgerald in overtime
note: 2015 Divisional, Packers at Cardinals, Jan 16, 2016. Rodgers' Hail Mary to Jeff Janis had forced overtime. Your ball at your own 20 to start it. Palmer's first throw went to Fitzgerald for 75 yards; the shovel pass two plays later ended it, 26–20.

title: The Fail Mary
note: Sep 24, 2012, Packers at Seahawks, the replacement referees' last game. Down 12–7, your ball at the Green Bay 46 with 46 seconds left, no timeouts. Wilson's last throw into the end zone was ruled a simultaneous catch for Golden Tate. Seahawks 14–12.

title: Daniels' Hail Mary
note: Oct 27, 2024, Bears at Commanders. Down 15–12, your ball at your own 24 with 19 seconds left, one timeout. Daniels bought six seconds and threw it 52 yards; Noah Brown caught the tip at the goal line as time expired.

title: Campbell's fourth downs
note: 2023 NFC Championship, Lions at 49ers, Jan 28, 2024. The Lions had led 24–7 at the half; now it was 27–24 San Francisco with 9:52 left. Your ball at your own 25, three timeouts. The drive ended on fourth and three at the 30, and Dan Campbell went for it again.

title: Dez caught it
note: 2014 Divisional, Cowboys at Packers, Jan 11, 2015. Down 26–21, your ball at your own 18 with 9:05 left. Murray ran for 30 on the first snap. On fourth and two at the 32 with 4:42 left, Romo went deep to Bryant; the catch at the one was overturned on review.
